title: Discover Canada – The Rights and Responsibilities of Citizenship
description: Comprehensive multiple choice question bank based on the official Canadian citizenship study guide. Designed for random question selection for mass audiences.

questions.question: What is the citizenship test usually in the form of?

options.b: A written test, but it could be an interview

options.b: The right to challenge unlawful detention by the state
options.c: The right to freedom of speech
options.d: The right to a fair trial

questions.question: Which of the following is a legal responsibility of Canadian citizenship?

questions.question: What are the two official languages of Canada?

options.b: English and French

options.b: Buying Canadian-made goods

questions.question: Which responsibility involves protecting Canada's natural, cultural and architectural heritage?
